EDEN PERSONAL GRAND BACKUP — v2.0

This expands the earlier registry-centric backup into a personal working
corpus for rebuilding Lucas’s EDEN environment.

It includes: Grand packs + Apps + Helpers + rules + LINGUA + Design
Mantra/AppDev canon + HESPERA/HESTIA prototyping +
professional/portfolio/work-search data + hardware/electronics/repair +
travel + agriculture/sustainability + private pseudonymous
health-workspace schema + Workspace/workflow/specialist definitions.

It is intentionally layered: PUBLIC / PERSONAL / PRIVATE / PSEUDONYMOUS
/ SECRET.

SECRET credentials are not duplicated. Sensitive medical/psychological
facts are not invented; the package provides a private pseudonymous
schema and only source-supported data should populate it.

The package is designed to seed: PERSONAL WORKSPACES → REUSABLE
WORKFLOWS → SPECIALIST/AGENT ROUTING → GENERALIZED edenOS/AppDev
CAPABILITIES.
